def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_lines = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    sep = grid[row_lines[0]][0]
    base = max((v for row in grid for v in row if v != sep), key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in grid for x in row))
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_lines + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_lines + [w]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri]+1, row_bounds[ri+1]
        outrow = []
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci]+1, col_bounds[ci+1]
            marks = sum(grid[r][c] != base and grid[r][c] != sep for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1))
            outrow.append(1 if marks >= 2 else base)
        out.append(outrow)
    return out
